title: “OpenConnect” Connection information is not displayed
line: The Networks widget and the Wi-Fi & Networking settings now show the IP address, gateway and DNS servers of a connected VPN.
explanation: ConnectionDetails::getConnectionDetails() decides whether a connection is active by comparing it with device->activeConnection(). A VPN item in the widget has no device, and in the KCM it gets the base Wi-Fi/Ethernet device, whose active connection is the base connection, so a connected VPN was always treated as inactive and only its plugin name was shown. The change looks up the VPN's own active connection in NetworkManager's active connections and takes the IPv4/IPv6 configuration from it; other connection types keep using the device as before.

commits.message:
connectiondetails: show IP addresses of active VPN connections

A VPN is never the active connection of a device, so the details only
saw it as inactive and showed nothing but its plugin. Find its own
active connection instead and take the IP configuration from there.

BUG: 516854

media.caption: Networks widget, connected OpenConnect VPN, Details tab: only the VPN plugin is listed
Same VPN: IPv4 and IPv6 address, gateway and nameserver are shown
Wi-Fi & Networking settings, Status tab of the connected VPN: only the plugin
Same Status tab with the VPN's IPv4 and IPv6 details

review.text: Solid, well-scoped fix in plasma-nm's ConnectionDetails::getConnectionDetails(): active VPN connections are now looked up via NetworkManager::activeConnections() rather than device->activeConnection(), and their IPv4/IPv6 configs are read from the VPN active connection while keeping isVpnActive separate so the underlying Ethernet/Wi-Fi device is not misleadingly shown as the VPN's device. This also restores VPN banner display and leaves wired/Wi-Fi/disconnected behavior intact. Before/after screenshots verify both the Networks widget and the KCM Status tab.

reviews.text: Solid, well-scoped fix in plasma-nm's ConnectionDetails::getConnectionDetails(): active VPN connections are now looked up via NetworkManager::activeConnections() rather than device->activeConnection(), and their IPv4/IPv6 configs are read from the VPN active connection while keeping isVpnActive separate so the underlying Ethernet/Wi-Fi device is not misleadingly shown as the VPN's device. This also restores VPN banner display and leaves wired/Wi-Fi/disconnected behavior intact. Before/after screenshots verify both the Networks widget and the KCM Status tab.

Correct root cause: getConnectionDetails() only treated a connection as active if it was its device's active connection, which a plugin VPN never is, so the IP sections were skipped in both the applet and the KCM Status tab. The fix looks up the VPN's own ActiveConnection and takes IPv4/IPv6 config from it (which for NM plugin VPNs is the VPN's config), leaving the device path untouched for every other type; it also makes the existing Banner code reachable. Evidence covers both the widget and KCM with a realistic dbusmock layout, plus a Wired regression check and a deactivated-VPN check. Small, clean, in the right repo and the commit message matches the diff.
